api_keys_key_hash_unique: credential identity: a revoked key's hash must resolve to exactly one row, tombstones included, or a deleted key can be re-issued while its dead twin still authenticates
billing_events_stripe_event_id_unique: webhook idempotency: the provider re-delivers an event it already delivered, and a dedupe arm that ignores tombstones books the money twice
email_verifications_token_hash_unique: one-time token: presenting a secret must resolve to one row including tombstones
invitations_token_unique: one-time token: a redeemed or withdrawn invitation must keep resolving, not accept a second row with the same token
password_resets_token_unique: one-time token: a consumed reset token must never match a live row as well
refresh_tokens_token_unique: session credential: rotating a token must not leave two rows a bearer can resolve
support_tickets_portal_token_unique: portal capability token: the anonymous portal keys on it and must resolve to one ticket
storage_documents_storage_key_unique: object-store key identity: two rows naming one key means a restore silently clobbers the live document's bytes
users_email_unique: auth identity, deliberately left absolute: making it partial means auditing every login and lookup path for a deleted_at filter first, which is its own change (follow-up to #3406)
uq_whatsapp_msg_tenant_external: provider message id: the vendor re-delivers, and a dedupe arm that ignores tombstones duplicates the conversation row
system_settings_key_unique: singleton config per key: these rows are upserted, never trashed
feature_registry_feature_name_unique: registry row per feature name: read as the authority on what exists, including retired features (#3415)
plans_slug_unique: billing catalog: a retired plan must stay un-reusable so old subscriptions resolve
plan_limits_plan_id_unique: one limits row per plan: aggregate config, upserted not trashed
tenant_token_limits_tenant_id_unique: one limits row per tenant: aggregate config, upserted not trashed
idx_ai_module_config_unique: one config row per (tenant,module): upserted, not trashed
idx_ai_usage_agg_unique: one aggregate row per (tenant,module,period): partiality double-counts a billing period
uniq_ai_providers_provider_key: platform provider catalog: the catalogue key names a provider forever
contact_scores_contact_id_unique: one score row per contact: recomputed by upsert, and a tombstone must not let a second live score exist
uniq_tenant_ai_credential_active: key already carries status, so the live/deleted question is entangled with the active/inactive one; needs the credential delete path audited first (follow-up to #3406)
idx_login_blocks_identifier_type: security counter: one blocking row per identifier must hold across tombstones, or a blocked principal gets a fresh counter from a deleted block row
idx_token_budgets_service_period: one budget row per (service, billing_period): an aggregate, upserted not trashed — partiality lets a deleted period and a live one both describe the same spend
idx_user_usage_unique: one aggregate row per (tenant, user): partiality lets a retired usage row and a live one coexist for the same user
